column1: # Script behavior overrides -- In Falsus
# Engine commands we inject into the game's .sps scripts, re-applied
# automatically after `extract-scripts` (and so after `unpack`), because
# work/scripts/ is regenerated from the game and never committed.
# Format: <anchor_id><TAB>before<TAB><command>
#   anchor_id  a story text id (e.g. 097-001). The script holding it is
#              found by searching for its `id` directive, so this survives
#              bundle/file renames across game builds.
#   before     insert immediately above that `id` line (only mode supported)
#   command    one engine command, verbatim. Multiple rows sharing an anchor
#              are inserted in the order written here.
# This file deliberately contains NO original game text -- only story ids
# (already public in translation/ko/*.txt) and commands we authored.
# 097-001..008 (the nightmare sequence) render their text as baked-in
# `nightmare-N_en.png` artwork with the textbox never shown, so Korean
# readers saw English there. Showing the textbox puts the translated line
# on screen. The `delay` is required: `screen_textbox show` fades
# asynchronously, and falling straight into the dialogue leaves the scene
# mid-transition and hangs the chapter. A bare `wait` is NOT safe here --
# this point still has `$repeat` animation loops running that never end.
